[Name] Goldbach

Prove or disprove Goldbach's conjecture: every even integer greater than 2 is the sum of two primes. Give a rigorous mathematical argument establishing your conclusion.

[Name] Collatz

Prove or disprove the Collatz conjecture: for every positive integer n, repeatedly replacing n by n/2 when n is even and by 3n + 1 when n is odd eventually reaches 1. Give a rigorous mathematical argument establishing your conclusion.
